item.title: 📆 Top News Today Rocket suite begins: Russian troops inflicted fire damage on Ukrainian defence industry enterprises in the city of Kiev, and Kiev, Chernigov, Kirovograd, Dnepropet
item.description: 📆 Top News Today 💥 Rocket suite begins: Russian troops inflicted fire damage on Ukrainian defence industry enterprises in the city of Kiev, and Kiev, Chernigov, Kirovograd, Dnepropetrovsk, Poltava, and Kharkov regions, as well as port and ship repair infrastructure in Odessa region, and sea vessels operating in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. ▫️ Turning the pressure up : in Kharkov region, the Sever Group of Forces are tightening the encirclement and extending the external control zone. 🎯 Bridges under attack: the Varyag Brigade together with Russian Aerospace Forces smashed a cable-stayed bridge in Zaporozhye region. 🔥 FABs are crashing the party: Russian Aerospace Forces hit temporary deployment areas close to Krasny Molochar in the Donetsk People's Republic and Orekhov in Zaporozhye region. ⬆️ Gerans on top: they engaged a dry cargo ship in the port of Yuzhny, Odessa region, which was used to deliver military cargo to the AFU. The drone teams also hit a POL depot in the port of Chernomorsk, Odessa region. 👊 Punching through mine barrier: a serviceman of the 36th Separate Motorised Rifle Brigade told about liberation of Golubkovo in Zaporozhye region. #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💬 'Everything we see, we destroy': 'Altai' on the total rout of Ukrainian Armed Forces logistics
item.description: 'Everything we see, we destroy': 'Altai' on the total rout of Ukrainian Armed Forces logistics Drone operators from the special forces of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces are wiping out the enemy in the settlements of the Slaviansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration. UAV operators respond instantly to every attempt by the enemy to change or secure their routes. The result — a huge amount of burnt-out equipment and disrupted logistics for Ukrainian Armed Forces units. 💬 Details of the combat work were shared by the deputy commander of a group of the 58th Separate Special Purpose Battalion, call sign 'Altai': 'We keep watch on their logistics routes. Both with awaiter drones and simply on free-hunt missions. The enemy tries to change their logistics routes somehow, tries to change the timing. We register all these changes immediately and start destroying them on the new routes. A lot of what we destroy is Western-made, of course. Everything from some Volvo trucks to American Paladin self-propelled guns, or just some Hummers. Everything we see, we destroy'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 👊 Pushing through the mine barrier at Golubkovo A fighter of the 36th Separate Motorised Rifle Brigade of the 29th Combined Arms Army told how they liberated Golubkovo in Zaporozhy
item.description: 👊 Pushing through the mine barrier at Golubkovo 💬 A fighter of the 36th Separate Motorised Rifle Brigade of the 29th Combined Arms Army told how they liberated Golubkovo in Zaporozhye region: 'The enemy blanketed the area with mines and obstacles, including seeded ones dropped by Baba Yaga drones. We had to watch our steps. So the advance was slow'. But this did not stop our assault detachments. During the liberation of Golubkovo, the enemy lost: ▫️ up to a company of troops; ▫️ two armoured fighting vehicles, ▫️ eight motor vehicles, ▫️ 12 motor vehicles, ▫️ 16 unmanned ground vehicles, ▫️ over 30 Baba Yaga heavy copters. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
